sources.title: Etsy · cable organizers 3D printed
sources.summary: 3D-printed cable organizers dominate the top-10 grid: 40+ shops with 200-800 sales, most listings $8–$15. Popular styles: minimalist desk clip, headphone cradle, monitor-back clip.
sources.evidence: Top 10 listings avg 250 sales; median price $12; five shops shipping in <2 days.

sources.title: Etsy · cord keeper competitors
sources.summary: Cord keepers overlap category. Prices $10–$18. Reviews cite 'stronger than store-bought' and 'matches my desk'.
sources.evidence: 3 shops with 1000+ sales; repeat-buyer language in reviews.

sources.title: r/3Dprinting · idle printer money threads
sources.summary: Community consensus: functional small items (organizers, brackets) outsell novelty prints. Cable/cord products cited repeatedly.
sources.evidence: Threads from last 90 days; 3 with >200 upvotes recommending cable organizers as first product.

candidates.name: cable organizers
candidates.evidence: 40+ shops in top grid; median $12; strong review sentiment; recommended in community threads.

candidates.name: cord keepers
candidates.evidence: Overlapping category; higher price band but slower turnover.

candidates.name: headphone stands
candidates.evidence: Popular but crowded — top shops have 5000+ sales, high competition for new entrants.
